source: State Historical and Architectural Reserve Khotyn Fortress
interpretation: Published external tower heights include rock and foundation datums. Model tower elevations use courtyard-relative measurements.
A 9m west-tower exterior is a photographic estimate; the published 5m diameter does not specify its datum clearly.
Five roofed towers, curved pale walls, geometric brick bands and two courtyard ranges are the identity features retained at medium-fi.
Plan spacing, foundation depth, parapets, roof pitches, windows and decorative bands are reconstructed. No exact surveyed inner-citadel footprint is available in the cached map evidence.
reuse: Reference links only. No third-party photographs, bitmap textures or mesh geometry are redistributed.
